try { reviewGeneratorTarget09(...$generator); } catch (Error $e) { echo "T|", $e->getLine(), "|", $e->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "FRAME|"; }

purpose: The same key-order Error releases the earlier sent object while an independently kept CV retains the paused Generator/current value; finally and current retirement wait for explicit unset.
